text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're training during summer camp, and Biwa Hayahide is running under the blistering sun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… There… I've finished ten beach dashes. What's next on the list?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No. I made sure to drink plenty of water before we started.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's increase the intensity of my exercises a little. Can you make sure to record my numbers accurately?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I want to determine the extent of my endurance and how much more I can improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems really serious. What should we move on to next?
choice_data_list: All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
Let's add a forty-kilometer marathon to your plate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems really serious. What should we move on to next?
choice_data_list: All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
Let's add a forty-kilometer marathon to your plate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Uh, aerobic hell?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I connect speakers to my phone and start playing some music.

text_block_list.name: Speakers
text_block_list.text: Hi, everyone! ♪ I'm Buff Chick, and welcome to a Happy Hell of an Aerobics workout! Now, lift that leg up—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Speakers
text_block_list.text: Okay, warm-up's over! ♪ How ya feelin'? Now it's time to get that upper body burning! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-but I've been doing this for an hour already… Agh… That was… just the warm-up?!

text_block_list.name: Speakers
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Don't forget to SMILE! Now let's work those glutes! Let me see you flex! And flex! One more time now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Urrgghhh! Who came up with this torture?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A marathon… That would certainly help train all my muscle groups, and not just the ones I need for sprinting…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But forty kilometers is practically a full marathon. If I start running now… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, I'll do it. I'm the one who asked for harder training. If I can't handle this, then I should just give up on my dreams right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll show you that I can push through my limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide starts her forty-kilometer marathon. This will be a good test of her overall condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Quite some time later…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it myself! My baseline endurance has really improved!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: All that training since the Derby has really paid off!
choice_data_list: It sure has! You've been working so hard.
It sure has! You've been working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no need to lay it on so thick. The only reason I performed poorly before was because I lacked the conviction to push myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Maybe all of this time, I've just been ignoring the fact that I could choose to step beyond my self-imposed limits.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The day I was overtaken and pushed myself too hard to catch up, leading to my injury… Ever since then, I've been playing it safe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I've moved on to the next stage! I have infinite possibilities before me, and the world is mine!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I hope I didn't sound too conceited just now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe… That's good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now all I have to do is put in a good showing at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I listen to Biwa Hayahide's promises to herself as we leave the sunset-bathed beach.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Training starts at 8 a.m. tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (I'm improving faster than I previously calculated. Now all I have to do is wait to test myself in a race!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Still, I can't help thinking…)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (I guess they're still obsessed with the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby…)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I think I'll have some warm milk, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow. 10 o'clock. Race me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you'd better bring it 'cause I'm gonna do the same, and I'm gonna beat you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph. We'll see about that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Right now, you're my biggest threat.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Oh…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat both of you at the Kikuka Sho… and claim first place on the podium.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, how odd. There's nothing strange with what Taishin is saying…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But my heart is beating so fast. I wonder why I feel like this?
